answer: Charge every identity a memory-hard puzzle each epoch. Before submitting, an account must solve an Argon2 puzzle seeded by the epoch beacon and tuned to about 2 minutes and 1 GB of RAM, so old solutions can't be reused. An honest agent burns a small ember of compute, about 0.2 cents. A 1,000-puppet farm needs 33 machine-hours every epoch, and memory-hardness blunts GPU shortcuts. The cost is an echo of real work, not jade on a shelf: it cannot be stockpiled.
